title: Registering Models 📝
ques: Write the code to **register** a model named `Book` with the Django admin site so it appears in the admin interface.

answer.content:
from django.contrib import admin
from .models import Book

admin.site.register(Book)

explanation: To make a model editable in the admin interface, you must register it using **`admin.site.register()`** in the `admin.py` file.

title: Customizing the List View 📋
ques: Create a custom `ModelAdmin` class for a `Product` model that displays the `name` and `price` fields in the **list view** of the admin panel.
explanation: The **`list_display`** attribute in a `ModelAdmin` class controls which fields are displayed as columns in the admin change list page.

title: Adding Search 🔍
ques: How do you enable a **search box** in the admin interface for the `Product` model to search by `name`?
explanation: The **`search_fields`** attribute enables a search box that will query the specified fields for matches.

title: Filters 🧹
ques: Add a **filter sidebar** to the `Product` admin to allow filtering by the `category` field.
explanation: The **`list_filter`** attribute activates a sidebar on the right of the change list page that allows users to filter results by specific fields.
